name: Dazzle
description:
You create a dazzling illusion around yourself. Roll Insight vs Awareness against each creature within short range. On each win, the creature is blinded for 1 round.

Describe the illusion.
successes:
✨: On each win, the creature also checks a Condition.

🌞: On each win, the creature is blinded for 1 additional round. On each loss, the creature checks a Condition.

improvements.name: Dazzling Blast
improvements.description: You may spend an additional 4 MP when you cast this spell. If you do, on each win, the creature's speed, actions and reactions are reduced to 0 for 1 round.
